topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Oh man, I just heard the news about the building. Everything’s changing, and I’m not sure how to take it. The very walls I thought were just mine, part of my life, might no longer be a sure thing. What does this mean for all of us? Are we really just temporary, even when we thought we were planting roots? I mean, I get it, change happens, but this feels so sudden. We’ve all got so much history here, so many late nights and early mornings. It’s just a lot to take in, you know? I don’t want to lose this place—it feels like home.
